Body.Content:
Visual Designer shows your entire contact center configuration as one interactive map: channels, workstreams, classification and routing rules, queues, and overflow handling, and how they connect. Admins can see how conversations will flow, spot gaps or misconfigurations, and make common changes, such as moving representatives between queues or updating routing, directly on the canvas instead of navigating many separate settings pages.

More info: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/contact-center/administer/visualize-edit-configuration-with-visual-designer

GA date: January CY2027

Preview date: November CY2026
